title.zh: 卷381 列傳一百六十八 帅承瀛 孙远燡 弟承瀚 左辅 姚祖同 程含章 康绍镛 朱桂桢 陈銮 吴其濬 张澧中 张日晸
title.en: Volume 381 Biographies 168: Shuai Cheng Ying, Sun Yuanyi, Di Cheng Han, Zuo Fu, Yao Zutong, Cheng Hanzhang, Kang Shaoyong, Zhu Guizhen, Chen Luan, Wu Qijun, Zhang Lizhong, Zhang Rizheng
title.raw: 卷381 列傳一百六十八 帅承瀛 孙远燡 弟承瀚 左辅 姚祖同 程含章 康绍镛 朱桂桢 陈銮 吴其濬 张澧中 张日晸

sentences.zh: =帥承瀛=帥承瀛，字仙舟，湖北黃梅人。

translations.literal: Shuai Cheng Ying, styled Xianzhou, was a native of Huangmei in Hubei.
translations.idiomatic: Shuai Cheng Ying, whose courtesy name was Xianzhou, came from Huangmei in Hubei.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶元年一甲三名進士，授編修，累遷國子監祭酒。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Jiaqing reign he placed third in the first class of the jinshi examinations; he was appointed Compiler and was promoted in due course to Director of the Imperial Academy.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 1 he finished third in the top tier of the metropolitan examinations and was made a Hanlin compiler, rising step by step to become Director of the Imperial Academy.

sentences.zh: 先後督廣西、山東學政，歷太僕寺卿、通政使、副都御史，署倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: He served successively as educational commissioner in Guangxi and Shandong, passed through the posts of Minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud, Commissioner of Communications, and Vice Censor-in-Chief, and acted as Vice Minister in charge of the grain depots.
translations.idiomatic: He later superintended education in Guangxi and Shandong in turn, and held the offices of Minister of the Imperial Stud, Commissioner of Communications, and Vice Censor-in-Chief, besides serving as acting Vice Minister for the grain depots.

sentences.zh: 授禮部侍郎，調工部、吏部。

translations.literal: He was appointed Vice Minister of Rites and was transferred to the Ministries of Works and Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: He was made Vice Minister of Rites, then transferred to the Ministries of Works and Personnel.

sentences.zh: 丁母憂，服闋，補原官，調刑部。

translations.literal: Upon his mother's death he entered mourning; when the mourning period ended he resumed his former post and was transferred to the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: After mourning his mother and completing the mourning period, he returned to his former office and was moved to the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 論劾郎中寶齡婪賄狀，仁宗以承瀛到官浹月，釐剔宿弊，予議敘。

translations.literal: He memorialized impeaching the director Bao Ling for extortionate bribery; the Emperor Renzong, because Cheng Ying had been in office barely a month yet had cleared away long-standing abuses, granted him a record for merit consideration.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial impeaching Director Bao Ling for greedy bribery. Emperor Renzong noted that although Cheng Ying had been in office only a month, he had already rooted out entrenched abuses, and ordered that his service be entered for merit consideration.

sentences.zh: 奉命按山西雁平道福海、陝甘總督先福，罷之。

translations.literal: By imperial order he investigated Fu Hai, intendant of the Yanping Circuit in Shanxi, and Xian Fu, governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu, and had them dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On imperial commission he investigated Fu Hai, intendant of Shanxi's Yanping Circuit, and Xian Fu, governor-general of Shaanxi-Gansu, and secured their dismissal.

sentences.zh: 又按山東徐文誥冤獄，得平反，劾承審官吏，降黜有差。

translations.literal: He also investigated the wrongful case of Xu Wengao in Shandong, secured a reversal of the verdict, and impeached the officials who had conducted the trial, who were demoted or dismissed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: He also reinvestigated the wrongful conviction of Xu Wengao in Shandong, obtained a reversal, and impeached the trial officials, who were demoted or dismissed to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 十五年，授浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year he was appointed governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of the reign he was appointed governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 浙鹽疲敝，議裁浙江鹽政，歸巡撫兼理，詔責承瀛整頓，疏言：「浙江運庫尚無虧挪，惟多移墊。

translations.literal: The salt administration of Zhejiang was exhausted; it was proposed to abolish the Zhejiang salt commissioner and have the governor take concurrent charge. An edict charged Cheng Ying to put matters in order. He memorialized, saying: "Zhejiang's transport treasury has not yet suffered embezzlement, but there has been much shifting and padding of accounts.
translations.idiomatic: Zhejiang's salt trade was in decline. The court proposed abolishing the Zhejiang salt commissioner and placing salt affairs under the governor's concurrent management. An edict ordered Cheng Ying to set matters right. In a memorial he wrote: "Zhejiang's transport treasury has not yet been plundered outright, but accounts are constantly shifted and padded.

sentences.zh: 擬以報存餘價追補，須足額後撥解。

translations.literal: It is proposed to make up the shortfall from reported surplus balances, and remittances should be made only after the full quota is restored.
translations.idiomatic: I propose to make up the deficit from reported surplus balances, and to remit funds only after the full quota has been restored.

sentences.zh: 至收支數目，務劃清綱款，即有急務，不再以內款墊支。

translations.literal: As for receipts and disbursements, the main categories of accounts must be kept distinct; even when urgent business arises, internal funds must no longer be used to cover advances.
translations.idiomatic: Receipts and disbursements must be kept strictly separated by category; even urgent business must no longer be covered by advances from internal funds.

sentences.zh: 每年加價，應許停輸。

translations.literal: The annual surcharges should be allowed to cease.
translations.idiomatic: The annual surcharges should be permitted to stop.

sentences.zh: 向例灑帶鹽引，豫佔年額，愈積愈多，請並停止，以紓商力。

translations.literal: By longstanding practice extra salt certificates were issued in advance of the annual quota, and the backlog grew ever larger; he requested that this too be halted to relieve the merchants.
translations.idiomatic: Under longstanding practice extra salt certificates were issued ahead of the annual quota, and the backlog kept growing; I ask that this practice be stopped as well, to ease the burden on merchants.

sentences.zh: 」又酌改章程十事：定鹽務官制，裁鹽政養廉，革掣規供應，灶課由場徵解，銷引先正後餘，引目通融行銷，收支力杜弊混，梟私商私並禁，掣驗改复兩季，甲商酌裁節費，下部議行。

translations.literal: " He also drafted ten revised regulations: fixing the official structure of salt affairs, cutting the salt commissioner's supplemental salary, abolishing inspection fees and supplies, collecting furnace taxes at the salterns for remittance, selling regular certificates before surplus ones, allowing certificate quotas to be flexibly marketed, strictly preventing mingling of receipts and disbursements, banning both smuggling and private trade, changing inspection to twice a year, and trimming head-merchant expenses as appropriate; the ministries deliberated and implemented them.
translations.idiomatic: " He also drafted ten revised regulations: fixing the official structure of salt administration, cutting the salt commissioner's supplemental salary, abolishing inspection fees and perquisites, collecting furnace taxes at the salterns for direct remittance, selling regular certificates before surplus ones, allowing certificate quotas to be marketed flexibly, strictly separating receipts and disbursements to block fraud, banning both smuggling and private dealing, changing inspections to twice a year, and trimming head-merchant expenses where appropriate. The ministries deliberated and put them into effect.

sentences.zh: 浙鹺自此漸有起色。

translations.literal: From this time the salt administration of Zhejiang gradually revived.
translations.idiomatic: From then on Zhejiang's salt administration gradually recovered.

sentences.zh: 寧波、溫、台諸府濱海，土盜出沒，令兵船巡緝以遏其外，嚴诇口岸以防其內，洋面漸安。

translations.literal: The prefectures of Ningbo, Wenzhou, and Taizhou lie along the coast, where local bandits came and went; he ordered armed patrol vessels to intercept them offshore and tightened surveillance at the ports to block them inland, and the coastal waters gradually grew calm.
translations.idiomatic: The coastal prefectures of Ningbo, Wenzhou, and Taizhou were plagued by local bandits. He ordered armed patrol vessels to intercept them at sea and tightened surveillance at the ports to block them inland, and the coastal waters gradually grew secure.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督孫玉庭上八折收漕之議，廷臣多言其不可，下疆臣覆議。

translations.literal: Sun Yuting, governor-general of Liangjiang, memorialized a proposal to collect grain transport tax at eighty percent; many court officials said it was unworkable, and the matter was referred to frontier governors for further deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yuting, governor-general of Liangjiang, proposed collecting grain transport tax at eighty percent of the levy. Many court officials argued that this would not work, and the matter was referred to the frontier governors for further discussion.

sentences.zh: 承瀛疏言：「漕弊始由州縣浮收，以致幫丁需索，而幫丁沿途用費亦因以漸增。

translations.literal: Cheng Ying memorialized, saying: "Abuses in grain transport began with over-collection by prefectures and counties, which led to demands by the transport coolies, and the coolies' expenses along the route therefore also increased step by step.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Ying memorialized: "Abuses in the grain transport system began when prefectures and counties collected more than the statutory amounts, which led transport coolies to make ever greater demands, and their expenses along the route therefore rose steadily in turn.

sentences.zh: 迨幫丁用費愈大，需索愈多，州縣迫於幫費，有難循舊例徵收之勢，其究耗費歸之小民。

translations.literal: As the coolies' expenses grew larger and their demands multiplied, prefectures and counties, pressed by transport costs, found it hard to collect according to the old quotas; in the end the waste fell upon the common people.
translations.idiomatic: As coolie expenses grew and their demands multiplied, prefectures and counties, squeezed by transport costs, found it increasingly difficult to collect according to the old quotas, and in the end ordinary people bore the waste.

sentences.zh: 由此包戶侵漁，刁衿挾制，積弊至不可回。

translations.literal: From this came encroachment by contract brokers and coercion by crafty degree-holders, until accumulated abuses became irreversible.
translations.idiomatic: Contract brokers then encroached for profit, crafty degree-holders used their leverage to coerce officials, and accumulated abuses became impossible to reverse.

sentences.zh: 八折之議，原以去其太甚，補救目前。

translations.literal: The eighty-percent proposal was originally meant to remove the worst excesses and provide a present remedy.
translations.idiomatic: The eighty-percent proposal was originally meant to cut away the worst excesses and provide a stopgap remedy.

sentences.zh: 無如因弊立法，而弊即因法以生。

translations.literal: Yet when laws are made because of abuses, abuses are born from the laws themselves.
translations.idiomatic: Yet when laws are made to cure abuses, new abuses spring from the laws themselves.

sentences.zh: 誠有如廷臣所議，惟嚴禁官役需索，沿途之規費除，即幫丁之用費省，而州縣浮收勒折之弊，亦力絕其萌，庶愛民卹丁兩有裨益。

translations.literal: If, as the court officials argued, official runners' exactions are strictly forbidden and customary fees along the route are abolished, then the coolies' expenses will be reduced and the abuses of over-collection and forced discounting by prefectures and counties can also be cut off at the root, so that both the people may be cherished and the coolies relieved.
translations.idiomatic: If, as the court officials argued, we strictly forbid exactions by clerks and runners and abolish customary fees along the route, coolie expenses will fall and we can also cut off at the root the abuses of over-collection and forced discounting by prefectures and counties, benefiting both the people and the transport workers.

sentences.zh: 」疏上，前議遂寢。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, the earlier proposal was set aside.
translations.idiomatic: " Once the memorial was submitted, the earlier proposal was dropped.

sentences.zh: 清釐倉庫虧缺，奏請先就現任各官次第彌補；

translations.literal: He cleared up deficits in the granaries and memorialized that serving officials should make restitution in turn;
translations.idiomatic: He cleared up granary deficits and memorialized that serving officials should make restitution in turn;

sentences.zh: 又以浙西頻遭水患，應與江蘇合力疏濬，察勘形勢，偕孫玉庭等疏陳兩省水道原委，實共一流，請專任大員綜攬全局：詔韙之。

translations.literal: because western Zhejiang had suffered frequent floods, he argued that it should work with Jiangsu on dredging, surveyed the terrain, and together with Sun Yuting and others memorialized that the waterways of the two provinces shared a single source and course, requesting that a senior official be put solely in charge of the whole project; an edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: Because western Zhejiang had suffered repeated floods, he argued that the province should join Jiangsu in dredging works. After surveying the terrain, he and Sun Yuting and others memorialized that the waterways of the two provinces shared a single source and course and asked that a senior official be placed solely in charge of the whole project. The court approved.

sentences.zh: 尋去官。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward he left office.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he left office.

sentences.zh: 後陶澍至江蘇，乃先治吳淞江焉。

translations.literal: Later, when Tao Zhu arrived in Jiangsu, he first undertook work on the Wusong River.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when Tao Zhu took office in Jiangsu, he began by tackling the Wusong River.

sentences.zh: 承瀛治浙數年，以廉勤著。

translations.literal: Cheng Ying governed Zhejiang for several years and was noted for integrity and diligence.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Ying governed Zhejiang for several years and was known for integrity and diligence.

sentences.zh: 陸名揚者，歸安鄉民，以抗浮收得一鄉心，久為官吏所嫉，請兵掩捕，鄉民集眾抗拒，而名揚逸。

translations.literal: There was a man named Lu Mingyang, a villager of Gui'an, who by resisting over-collection won the hearts of his township and had long been envied by officials; troops were requested to seize him secretly, the villagers gathered to resist, and Mingyang escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Mingyang was a villager of Gui'an who, by resisting over-collection, won the loyalty of his township and had long been resented by local officials. When troops were sent to seize him, villagers gathered to resist and Mingyang escaped.

sentences.zh: 巡撫陳若霖遽以入告，遣兵往治，久之名揚始就獲。

translations.literal: Governor Chen Ruolin hastily reported the matter to the throne and dispatched troops to deal with it; only after a long time was Mingyang finally captured.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Chen Ruolin hastily reported the affair to the throne and sent troops to suppress it. Only after a long time was Mingyang finally captured.

sentences.zh: 承瀛初至浙，誅名揚，後乃知由於官吏之釀變，深悔之。

translations.literal: When Cheng Ying first arrived in Zhejiang he had Mingyang executed, but later learned that the affair had been provoked by officials and deeply regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: When Cheng Ying first arrived in Zhejiang he had Mingyang executed, but later learned that officials had provoked the crisis and deeply regretted it.

sentences.zh: 道光四年，丁父艱，服闋，至京，以目疾久不愈，乃乞歸。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of the Daoguang reign he mourned his father; when mourning ended he came to the capital, but because his eye ailment would not heal he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 4 he entered mourning for his father. When mourning ended he went to the capital, but because his eye ailment would not heal he asked to retire.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，卒於家。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of the reign he died at home.

sentences.zh: 優詔軫惜，依總督例加卹，賜其孫遠燡舉人，尋祀浙江名宦祠。

translations.literal: A gracious edict expressed sympathy; posthumous honors were added according to the precedent for governors, his grandson Yuanyi was granted the rank of provincial graduate, and he was soon enshrined in Zhejiang's shrine of eminent officials.
translations.idiomatic: The court issued a gracious edict of sympathy, added posthumous honors according to the precedent for governors, granted his grandson Yuanyi the rank of provincial graduate, and soon enshrined him in Zhejiang's shrine of eminent officials.

sentences.zh: 遠燡，成道光二十七年進士，官編修。

translations.literal: Yuanyi passed the jinshi examination in the twenty-seventh year of the Daoguang reign and served as Compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanyi passed the metropolitan examinations in Daoguang 27 and served as a Hanlin compiler.

sentences.zh: 咸豐初，上書言軍事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Xianfeng reign he submitted a memorial on military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xianfeng reign he submitted a memorial on military affairs.

sentences.zh: 納貲為道員，奏留江西勸辦捐輸。

translations.literal: By purchase he became an intendant and was retained in Jiangxi to promote contributions.
translations.idiomatic: He purchased office as an intendant and was kept in Jiangxi to promote war contributions.

sentences.zh: 七年，總兵李定為粵匪困於東鄉，遠燡募勇往援。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Brigadier Li Ding was besieged at Dongxiang by Guangdong bandits; Yuanyi raised volunteers to go to his relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Brigadier Li Ding was trapped at Dongxiang by Guangdong rebels. Yuanyi raised volunteers to relieve him.

sentences.zh: 戰歿，予騎都尉世職，建專祠，諡文毅。

translations.literal: He was killed in battle; he was granted the hereditary rank of Cavalry Commandant, a special shrine was built, and he was given the posthumous title Wenyi.
translations.idiomatic: He was killed in battle. The court granted the hereditary rank of Cavalry Commandant, built him a special shrine, and gave him the posthumous title Wenyi.

sentences.zh: 承瀛弟承瀚，嘉慶十年進士，由翰林院檢討歷官至副都御史，方正負時譽，名亞於承瀛。

translations.literal: Cheng Ying's younger brother Chenghan passed the jinshi in the tenth year of the Jiaqing reign; from Reviser in the Hanlin Academy he rose to Vice Censor-in-Chief. Upright and esteemed in his time, his reputation was second only to Cheng Ying's.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Ying's younger brother Chenghan passed the metropolitan examinations in Jiaqing 10 and rose from Hanlin reviser to Vice Censor-in-Chief. Upright and widely respected, his reputation was second only to his brother's.

sentences.zh: 歿，祀鄉賢。

translations.literal: After his death he was enshrined among the local worthies.
translations.idiomatic: After his death he was enshrined in the local worthies' temple.

sentences.zh: =左輔=左輔，字仲甫，江蘇陽湖人。

translations.literal: Zuo Fu, styled Zhongfu, was a native of Yanghu in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Fu, whose courtesy name was Zhongfu, came from Yanghu in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十八年進士，授安徽南陵知縣，調霍丘。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi in the fifty-eighth year of the Qianlong reign and was appointed magistrate of Nanling in Anhui, then transferred to Huoqiu.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examinations in Qianlong 58 and was appointed magistrate of Nanling in Anhui, then transferred to Huoqiu.

sentences.zh: 勤政愛民，坐催科不力免官，嘉慶四年，復之，補合肥，復以緝私役為鹽販毆斃獄坐奪職。

translations.literal: Diligent in government and caring toward the people, he was dismissed for ineffective tax collection; in the fourth year of the Jiaqing reign he was restored, appointed to Hefei, and again lost his post when, while suppressing private salt runners, a salt smuggler was beaten to death in prison.
translations.idiomatic: Diligent in office and devoted to the people, he was dismissed for ineffective tax collection. In Jiaqing 4 he was restored and appointed to Hefei, but lost his post again when a salt smuggler died in prison after being beaten while he was suppressing illegal salt runners.

sentences.zh: 尋初彭齡為安徽巡撫，薦輔人才可用，仁宗亦素知輔循名，能得民心，送部引見，復職，仍發安徽，補懷寧，遷泗州直隸州知州。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Chu Pengling became governor of Anhui and recommended Fu as a usable talent; Emperor Renzong also knew long that Fu cultivated his reputation and won the people's hearts. He was sent to the ministries for audience, restored to office, and again posted to Anhui as magistrate of Huaining, then promoted to prefect of Sizhou Direct Administration Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Chu Pengling became governor of Anhui and recommended Fu as a man of talent. Emperor Renzong had long known that Fu cultivated his reputation and won the people's hearts. Fu was sent to the capital for audience, restored to office, and posted again to Anhui as magistrate of Huaining, then promoted to prefect of Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 河決，州境被災，輔躬親賑撫，民無失所。

translations.literal: When the river burst its banks and the prefecture was stricken, Fu personally went to relieve and comfort the people, and none were left homeless.
translations.idiomatic: When the river burst its banks and the prefecture was stricken, Fu went in person to relieve and comfort the people, and none were left homeless.

sentences.zh: 總督百齡疏保洁己奉公，政聲為一時最，以應升升用，擢潁州知府。

translations.literal: Governor-General Bai Ling memorialized that he was self-restrained and devoted to public duty, and that his reputation for governance was the foremost of the age; on grounds of merit for promotion he was raised to prefect of Yingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Bai Ling memorialized that Fu was self-restrained and devoted to public duty and that his reputation for governance was the best of the day. On grounds of merit for promotion he was made prefect of Yingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十八年，盱眙民孫國柱誣周永泰謀逆，疆吏以聞。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year a man of Xuyi named Sun Guozhu falsely accused Zhou Yongtai of plotting rebellion, and the frontier officials reported it.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year a man of Xuyi named Sun Guozhu falsely accused Zhou Yongtai of plotting rebellion, and frontier officials reported the case.

sentences.zh: 詔那彥成俟滑縣匪平，移師會剿，檄輔先率兵往。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Na Yancheng, once the bandits at Huaxian were suppressed, to move his forces for a joint campaign; Fu was ordered to lead troops there first.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Na Yancheng, once the bandits at Huaxian were suppressed, to move his forces for a joint campaign and directed Fu to lead troops there first.

sentences.zh: 輔力言泗州屬縣無邪教，單騎往按之，得國柱誣告狀，大獄以息。

translations.literal: Fu strongly argued that there was no heterodox sect in the counties under Sizhou, went alone on horseback to investigate, obtained proof of Guozhu's false accusation, and the great case was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Fu insisted that there was no heterodox sect in the counties under Sizhou, rode alone to investigate, obtained proof of Guozhu's false accusation, and the major case was closed.

sentences.zh: 尋捕誅阜陽教匪李珠、王三保等，予議敘。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he captured and executed the sect rebels Li Zhu and Wang Sanbao of Fuyang, among others, and was entered for merit consideration.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he captured and executed the sect rebels Li Zhu and Wang Sanbao of Fuyang, among others, and was entered for merit consideration.

sentences.zh: 擢廣東雷瓊道，遷浙江按察使、湖南布政使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to intendant of the Lei-Qiong Circuit in Guangdong, then transferred to provincial judge of Zhejiang and provincial treasurer of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to intendant of Guangdong's Lei-Qiong Circuit, then transferred to provincial judge of Zhejiang and provincial treasurer of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，就擢巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was promoted directly to governor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was promoted directly to governor.

sentences.zh: 苗疆稅重，又苦官役苛擾，侍郎張映漢陳其弊，命輔偕總督陳若霖察治。

translations.literal: Taxes in the Miao frontier were heavy and the people also suffered harsh exactions by officials and runners; Vice Minister Zhang Yinghan reported these abuses, and Fu was ordered to investigate and remedy them together with Governor Chen Ruolin.
translations.idiomatic: Taxes in the Miao frontier were heavy and the people also suffered harsh exactions by officials and runners. Vice Minister Zhang Yinghan reported these abuses, and Fu was ordered to investigate and remedy them together with Governor Chen Ruolin.

sentences.zh: 奏減租穀二萬餘石，籌款買補倉儲六萬餘石，免民、苗積逋租穀七萬餘石。

translations.literal: He memorialized a reduction of more than twenty thousand shi of rent grain, raised funds to purchase more than sixty thousand shi to replenish the granaries, and remitted more than seventy thousand shi of accumulated arrears owed by Han and Miao alike.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized a reduction of more than twenty thousand shi of rent grain, raised funds to purchase more than sixty thousand shi to replenish the granaries, and remitted more than seventy thousand shi of accumulated arrears owed by Han and Miao alike.

sentences.zh: 復挑補兵勇，裁撤委員，禁差役不得入苗寨，聽苗食川鹽，民、苗便之。

translations.literal: He also selected and replenished troops, abolished supernumerary commissioners, forbade runners to enter Miao villages, and allowed the Miao to consume Sichuan salt, to the convenience of both Han and Miao.
translations.idiomatic: He also selected and replenished troops, abolished supernumerary commissioners, forbade runners to enter Miao villages, and allowed the Miao to consume Sichuan salt, to the benefit of both Han and Miao.

sentences.zh: 長沙妙高★有宋儒張栻城南書院舊址，康熙中移建城內，已圮，規復重建，課通省士子，疏請御書扁額，以示嘉惠士林，詔嘉許焉。

translations.literal: At Miaogaofeng in Changsha stood the old site of the Chengnan Academy of the Song scholar Zhang Shi; in the Kangxi reign it had been moved inside the city walls and had since fallen into ruin. Fu planned to restore and rebuild it to instruct scholars throughout the province, memorialized for an imperial inscription on the tablet to show favor to the scholarly community, and an edict commended this.
translations.idiomatic: At Miaogaofeng in Changsha stood the old site of the Chengnan Academy founded by the Song scholar Zhang Shi. In the Kangxi reign it had been moved inside the city walls and had since fallen into ruin. Fu planned to restore and rebuild it to instruct scholars throughout the province and memorialized for an imperial inscription on the tablet to show favor to the scholarly community. The court commended the proposal.

sentences.zh: 輔官安徽最久，時稱循吏，晚被拔擢，數年中至封圻，年已老。

translations.literal: Fu had served longest in Anhui and was called a model official of his time; late in life he was suddenly promoted, and within a few years rose to a frontier governorship, though he was already old.
translations.idiomatic: Fu had served longest in Anhui and was known as a model official of his day. Late in life he was suddenly promoted, and within a few years rose to a frontier governorship, though he was already old.

sentences.zh: 道光三年，召來京，原品休致。

translations.literal: In the third year of the Daoguang reign he was summoned to the capital and retired at his former rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 3 he was summoned to the capital and retired at his former rank.

sentences.zh: 十三年，卒於家。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he died at home.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of the reign he died at home.

sentences.zh: =姚祖同=姚祖同，字亮甫，浙江錢塘人。

translations.literal: Yao Zutong, styled Liangfu, was a native of Qiantang in Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Zutong, whose courtesy name was Liangfu, came from Qiantang in Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十九年，南巡，召試，賜舉人，授內閣中書，充軍機章京，累遷兵部郎中。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year of the Qianlong reign, during the southern tour, he was summoned for examination, granted the rank of provincial graduate, appointed Secretariat Drafter, served as a Grand Council clerk, and was promoted in due course to director in the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 49, during the southern tour, he was summoned for examination, granted the rank of provincial graduate, appointed Secretariat drafter, served as a Grand Council clerk, and rose step by step to director in the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 以纂輯剿平教匪方略，擢四五品京堂，補鴻臚寺少卿。

translations.literal: For compiling the strategic record of suppressing the sect rebels he was promoted to a fourth- or fifth-rank capital official and appointed Vice Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: For compiling the strategic record of suppressing the sect rebels he was promoted to a fourth- or fifth-rank capital official and appointed Vice Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 歷通政司參議、內閣侍讀學士、鴻臚寺卿。

translations.literal: He passed through the posts of counselor in the Office of Transmission, Reader in the Grand Secretariat, and Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: He held the posts of counselor in the Office of Transmission, reader in the Grand Secretariat, and Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 二十年，出為河南布政使。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he went out as provincial treasurer of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year of the reign he was appointed provincial treasurer of Henan.

sentences.zh: 請限制河工提款，清釐州縣交代，庫儲頓充。

translations.literal: He requested limits on withdrawals for river works, cleared up handovers between prefectures and counties, and the treasury stores were suddenly replenished.
translations.idiomatic: He requested limits on withdrawals for river works, cleared up handovers between prefectures and counties, and the treasury stores were quickly replenished.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，調山西，又調直隸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was transferred to Shanxi, then again to Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he was transferred to Shanxi, then to Zhili.

sentences.zh: 嚴查虧空，令州縣自報虧數，凡新任不得私受前任舊虧，其新虧者，勒停升補。

translations.literal: He strictly investigated deficits, ordered prefectures and counties to report their own shortfalls, forbade incoming officials privately to accept old deficits from predecessors, and compelled those who incurred new deficits to halt promotion.
translations.idiomatic: He strictly investigated deficits, ordered prefectures and counties to report their own shortfalls, forbade incoming officials from privately accepting old deficits from predecessors, and blocked promotion for those who incurred new deficits.

sentences.zh: 倉穀自經飢祲，兼軍需支領，蕩然無餘。

translations.literal: Granary grain, after famine and military requisitions, had been utterly exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: Granary stocks, depleted by famine and military requisitions, had been utterly exhausted.

sentences.zh: 祖同飭各屬糴補數十萬石。

translations.literal: Zutong ordered his subordinates to purchase grain to replenish several hundred thousand shi.
translations.idiomatic: Zutong ordered his subordinates to purchase grain and replenish several hundred thousand shi.

sentences.zh: 雄縣、安州、高陽諸縣水道淤阻，連年漫溢，並遴員治理，相機疏濬。

translations.literal: In the counties of Xiongxian, Anzhou, and Gaoyang the waterways were silted and blocked and overflowed year after year; he selected officials to manage them and dredged them as circumstances allowed.
translations.idiomatic: In Xiongxian, Anzhou, Gaoyang, and other counties the waterways were silted and blocked and overflowed year after year. He selected officials to manage them and dredged them as circumstances allowed.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，畿輔旱災，重者二十有九州縣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year drought struck the capital region; twenty-nine prefectures and counties were severely affected.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year drought struck the capital region, severely affecting twenty-nine prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 先令停徵，截漕備賑；

translations.literal: He first ordered collections suspended and grain transport diverted for relief;
translations.idiomatic: He first ordered tax collections suspended and diverted grain transport for relief;

sentences.zh: ★歷災區，劾屬吏辦賑不實者；

translations.literal: toured the disaster areas in person and impeached subordinate officials who handled relief dishonestly;
translations.idiomatic: toured the disaster areas in person and impeached subordinate officials who handled relief dishonestly;

sentences.zh: 發米賈囤積數十萬石，責令平糶，民賴以濟。

translations.literal: and released several hundred thousand shi hoarded by grain merchants, ordering them sold at fair prices, so the people were saved.
translations.idiomatic: and released several hundred thousand shi hoarded by grain merchants, ordering them sold at fair prices so the people were saved.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，仁宗東巡，灤河漲溢，祖同督造橋工成，賜花翎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Emperor Renzong toured east; the Luan River rose in flood, and Zutong supervised the bridge works to completion and was granted the peacock feather.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Emperor Renzong toured east. The Luan River rose in flood, Zutong supervised completion of the bridge works, and he was granted the peacock feather.

sentences.zh: 面諭曰：「是非為橋工，因汝能實心辦事耳。

translations.literal: The emperor addressed him in person, saying: "This is not for the bridge works; it is because you can handle affairs with a sincere heart.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor addressed him in person: "This is not for the bridge works. It is because you handle affairs with a sincere heart.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，擢安徽巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he was promoted to governor of Anhui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year he was promoted to governor of Anhui.

sentences.zh: 會河南大水，灌入渦河，下游諸縣被災，祖同乘小舟巡視賑恤。

translations.literal: When great floods in Henan poured into the Wo River and the downstream counties were stricken, Zutong toured the disaster areas in a small boat to oversee relief.
translations.idiomatic: When great floods in Henan poured into the Wo River and stricken downstream counties, Zutong toured the disaster areas in a small boat to oversee relief.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，調河南。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he was transferred to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he was transferred to Henan.

sentences.zh: 時儀封大工未竣，黃、沁並漲，漫及馬營工壩尾，祖同相機堵禦。

translations.literal: At that time the major works at Yifeng were not yet finished; the Yellow and Qin Rivers both rose together and overflowed to the tail of the Maying works dam, and Zutong blocked the flood as circumstances allowed.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the major works at Yifeng were unfinished. The Yellow and Qin Rivers rose together and overflowed to the tail of the Maying works dam, and Zutong blocked the flood as circumstances allowed.

sentences.zh: 疏陳政務雖多，河工為重；

translations.literal: He memorialized that although civil affairs were many, river works were paramount;
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that although civil affairs were many, river works were paramount;

sentences.zh: 學習河務，以履勘為先。

translations.literal: in studying river affairs, on-the-ground inspection must come first.
translations.idiomatic: and in studying river affairs, on-the-ground inspection must come first.

sentences.zh: 宣宗初即位，命祖同每屆旬以大工進占丈尺奏聞。

translations.literal: When Emperor Xuanzong first ascended the throne, he ordered Zutong every ten days to report the progress measurements of the major works.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuanzong first ascended the throne, he ordered Zutong to report progress measurements of the major works every ten days.

sentences.zh: 及冬，口門漸狹，而大河冰堅，祖同親乘小舟督工鑿冰，歲杪大工始告蕆。

translations.literal: By winter the mouth was gradually narrowing while the great river froze solid; Zutong himself took a small boat to supervise workers breaking ice, and only at year's end were the major works declared complete.
translations.idiomatic: By winter the mouth was gradually narrowing while the great river froze solid. Zutong himself took a small boat to supervise workers breaking ice, and only at year's end were the major works declared complete.

sentences.zh: 道光元年，祖同疏陳河南情形，略曰：「河工之敝壞顯而易見，民生之凋瘵隱而難治。

translations.literal: In the first year of the Daoguang reign Zutong memorialized on conditions in Henan, saying in summary: "The decay of river works is obvious and easy to see; the exhaustion of the people's livelihood is hidden and hard to cure.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 1 Zutong memorialized on conditions in Henan, writing in summary: "The decay of river works is obvious and easy to see; the exhaustion of the people's livelihood is hidden and hard to cure.

sentences.zh: 河工加價，自常賦三百六十餘萬外，逾額攤徵。

translations.literal: Surcharges for river works, beyond the regular levy of more than 3.6 million, were assessed in excess of quota.
translations.idiomatic: Surcharges for river works, beyond the regular levy of more than 3.6 million, were assessed in excess of quota.

sentences.zh: 衡工未已，睢工繼之；

translations.literal: The Heng works had not ended before the Sui works followed;
translations.idiomatic: The Heng works had not ended before the Sui works followed;

sentences.zh: 睢工未已，馬工、儀工又相繼接徵。

translations.literal: the Sui works had not ended before the Ma and Yi works levied assessments in turn.
translations.idiomatic: the Sui works had not ended before the Ma and Yi works levied assessments in turn.

sentences.zh: 此外復有各處堤工隨時攤徵之款，民力其何以堪？

translations.literal: Besides these there were also assessments levied at various times for dike works everywhere—how could the people's strength bear it?
translations.idiomatic: Besides these there were assessments levied at various times for dike works everywhere. How could the people's strength bear it?

sentences.zh: 請概停緩三年，以紓積困。

translations.literal: He requested that all be generally suspended for three years to relieve accumulated distress.
translations.idiomatic: He requested that all be generally suspended for three years to relieve accumulated distress.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 開封護城大堤，河溢時半圮，請繕完以資保障。

translations.literal: The great protective dike around Kaifeng had been half destroyed when the river overflowed; he requested that it be repaired to provide security.
translations.idiomatic: The great protective dike around Kaifeng had been half destroyed when the river overflowed. He requested that it be repaired to provide security.

sentences.zh: 二年，河督嚴烺奏請馬營壩工拋護碎石，已奉俞允，復命祖同籌度。

translations.literal: In the second year River Commissioner Yan Huang memorialized to cast protective rubble at the Maying dam works; approval had already been granted, and Zutong was again ordered to plan the matter.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year River Commissioner Yan Huang memorialized to cast protective rubble at the Maying dam works. Approval had already been granted, and Zutong was again ordered to plan the matter.

sentences.zh: 祖同言時當大堤放淤，遏其奔衝，既非順水之性，伏秋盛漲，壩西水勢加高，上游堤埝愈險，則河北可虞，且慮攔沁轉致攔黃，於實事為未便。

translations.literal: Zutong said that at this time the great dike should be allowed to discharge silt and restrain the rush of water; to do otherwise was against the nature of the current. At the summer and autumn flood season the water west of the dam would rise higher, the upstream dikes and embankments would grow more dangerous, and Hebei would be at risk; moreover he feared that blocking the Qin might end by blocking the Yellow River, which would be impractical in fact.
translations.idiomatic: Zutong argued that at this time the great dike should be allowed to discharge silt and restrain the rush of water, which was against the river's nature. At the summer and autumn flood season the water west of the dam would rise higher, upstream dikes and embankments would grow more dangerous, and Hebei would be at risk. He also feared that blocking the Qin might end by blocking the Yellow River, which would be impractical.

sentences.zh: 乃下烺覆議，卒如祖同言。

translations.literal: The matter was referred back to Huang for further deliberation, and in the end it followed Zutong's view.
translations.idiomatic: The matter was referred back to Huang for further deliberation, and in the end it followed Zutong's view.

sentences.zh: 初，儀工經費，自祖同嚴覈弊竇，省帑金甚鉅。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the funds for the Yi works, from the time Zutong strictly investigated abuses, a very large sum of treasury silver was saved.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in the funds for the Yi works, once Zutong strictly investigated abuses, a very large sum of treasury silver was saved.

sentences.zh: 迨工員報銷，截長補短，蘄合成例，言官以浮冒入奏。

translations.literal: When the works staff submitted accounts, they cut long and patched short, piecing together precedents, and censorial officials memorialized inflated claims.
translations.idiomatic: When the works staff submitted accounts, they cut long figures short and patched gaps to piece together precedents, and censorial officials memorialized inflated claims.

sentences.zh: 是年，命左都御史玉麟、王鼎按之，事得白，而以八子錢五萬六千餘緡責祖同償補。

translations.literal: That year the court ordered Left Censor-in-Chief Yulin and Wang Ding to investigate; the matter was cleared, but Zutong was ordered to compensate more than 56,000 strings of "eight-son" money.
translations.idiomatic: That year the court ordered Left Censor-in-Chief Yulin and Wang Ding to investigate. The matter was cleared, but Zutong was ordered to compensate more than 56,000 strings of "eight-son" money.

sentences.zh: 八子錢者​​，工員以雜用不敷，議以銀易錢，銀一兩加扣八十文，祖同置弗問，卒以罣議，降補太常寺少卿。

translations.literal: "Eight-son" money: when miscellaneous expenses fell short, works staff proposed exchanging silver for cash with an extra deduction of eighty wen per tael; Zutong ignored it and in the end was censured and demoted to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: "Eight-son" money was a scheme in which works staff, when miscellaneous expenses fell short, proposed exchanging silver for cash with an extra deduction of eighty wen per tael. Zutong ignored it and was eventually censured and demoted to Vice Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 五年，授陝西按察使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed provincial judge of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed provincial judge of Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 請建流芳祠以祀關中士女之死節義者。

translations.literal: He requested the building of a Liufang Shrine to sacrifice women of Guanzhong who died for chastity and righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: He requested building a Liufang Shrine to honor women of Guanzhong who died for chastity and righteousness.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔來京另候簡用。

translations.literal: In the sixth year an edict summoned him to the capital to await another appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year an edict summoned him to the capital to await another appointment.

sentences.zh: 七年，授廣東按察使。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed provincial judge of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was appointed provincial judge of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 尋偕尚書陳若霖赴湖北察勘京山王家營堤工。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he went with Minister Chen Ruolin to Hubei to inspect the dike works at Wangjiaying in Jingshan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he went with Minister Chen Ruolin to Hubei to inspect the dike works at Wangjiaying in Jingshan.

sentences.zh: 未幾，召授通政司副使，累遷左副都御史。

translations.literal: Before long he was summoned and appointed Vice Commissioner of the Office of Transmission, and was promoted in due course to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was summoned and appointed vice commissioner of the Office of Transmission, then rose step by step to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 十八年，以年老重聽，原品休致。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, because he was old and severely hard of hearing, he retired at his former rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, because he was old and severely hard of hearing, he retired at his former rank.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year he died.

sentences.zh: =程含章=程含章，雲南景東人。

translations.literal: Cheng Hanzhang was a native of Jingdong in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: Cheng Hanzhang came from Jingdong in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 其先佐官吏捕殺土寇，懼禍，改姓羅。

translations.literal: His ancestor had assisted officials in capturing and killing local bandits; fearing retribution, he changed the family name to Luo.
translations.idiomatic: His ancestor had assisted officials in capturing and killing local bandits. Fearing retribution, the family changed its surname to Luo.

sentences.zh: 乾隆五十七年舉人。

translations.literal: He became a provincial graduate in the fifty-seventh year of the Qianlong reign.
translations.idiomatic: He became a provincial graduate in Qianlong 57.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶初，大挑知縣，分廣東，署封川。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jiaqing reign he was selected as magistrate and assigned to Guangdong, acting as magistrate of Fengchuan.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Jiaqing reign he was selected as magistrate and assigned to Guangdong, serving as acting magistrate of Fengchuan.

sentences.zh: 坐回護前令諱盜，革職，投效海疆，屢殲獲劇盜，擢知州，署雷州府同知，率鄉勇破海盜烏石大，遷南雄直隸州；

translations.literal: He was dismissed for shielding his predecessor in concealing banditry, then offered service on the coast, repeatedly capturing major pirates, was promoted to prefect, acted as sub-prefect of Leizhou, led militia to defeat the pirate Wushi Da, and was transferred to Nanxiong Direct Administration Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed for shielding his predecessor in concealing banditry, then offered service on the coast, repeatedly captured major pirates, was promoted to prefect, served as acting sub-prefect of Leizhou, led militia to defeat the pirate Wushi Da, and was transferred to Nanxiong;

sentences.zh: 又坐失察屬縣虧空，革職，尋复官。

translations.literal: he was again dismissed for failing to detect deficits in a subordinate county, but was soon restored to office.
translations.idiomatic: He was again dismissed for failing to detect deficits in a subordinate county, but was soon restored to office.

sentences.zh: 以勘丈南雄州屬田畝，總督蔣攸銛疏薦，擢知府，補惠州。

translations.literal: For surveying the fields under Nanxiong Prefecture, Governor-General Jiang Youqian memorialized recommending him; he was promoted to prefect and appointed to Huizhou.
translations.idiomatic: For surveying the fields under Nanxiong Prefecture, Governor-General Jiang Youqian recommended him in a memorial. He was promoted to prefect and appointed to Huizhou.

sentences.zh: 歷山東兗沂曹道、按察使、河南布政使。

translations.literal: He passed through the posts of intendant of the Yan-Yi-Cao Circuit in Shandong, provincial judge, and provincial treasurer of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He held the posts of intendant of Shandong's Yan-Yi-Cao Circuit, provincial judge, and provincial treasurer of Henan.

sentences.zh: 道光二年，疏言：「欲治河南，必以治河為先務。

translations.literal: In the second year of the Daoguang reign he memorialized, saying: "To govern Henan, river works must be the first task.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 2 he memorialized: "To govern Henan, river works must come first.

sentences.zh: 正本清源之道，在河員大法小廉，實心修築，加意堤防，自能久安長治。

translations.literal: The way to cure the root lies in river officials observing great law and small integrity, repairing works with a sincere heart, and paying special attention to dikes, so that long peace and lasting order may be achieved of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The way to cure the root is for river officials to observe the law strictly and remain incorruptible, repair works sincerely, and pay special attention to dikes, so that lasting peace and order may follow.

sentences.zh: 」宣宗韙其言，命每屆汛期，赴工稽查工料及工員才否。

translations.literal: " Emperor Xuanzong approved his words and ordered that every flood season he go to the works to inspect materials and the competence of the staff.
translations.idiomatic: " Emperor Xuanzong approved his words and ordered that every flood season he go to the works to inspect materials and the competence of the staff.

sentences.zh: 擢廣東巡撫，入覲，面奏請復姓，許之。

translations.literal: He was promoted to governor of Guangdong; on audience he memorialized in person to restore his original surname, and this was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to governor of Guangdong. On audience he asked in person to restore his original surname, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 調山東，又調江西。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Shandong, then again to Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Shandong, then to Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 修築德化諸縣被水圩堤，設義倉，行平糶。

translations.literal: He repaired the flooded polder dikes in Dehua and other counties, established charity granaries, and carried out fair-price sales of grain.
translations.idiomatic: He repaired flooded polder dikes in Dehua and other counties, established charity granaries, and carried out fair-price grain sales.

sentences.zh: 四年，召署工部侍郎，治直隸水利，上疏略曰：「雍正、乾隆間四次興大工，皆歷數年蕆事，費帑數百萬，自此畿內無水患者​​數十年。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was summoned to act as Vice Minister of Works and manage water conservancy in Zhili. He memorialized in summary, saying: "Between the Yongzheng and Qianlong reigns four great projects were undertaken, each taking several years to complete at a cost of millions in treasury funds; from then the capital region was free of flood distress for several decades.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was summoned to act as Vice Minister of Works and manage water conservancy in Zhili. From then the capital region was free of flood distress for several decades.

sentences.zh: 迨嘉慶六年後，河道漸淤。

translations.literal: After the sixth year of the Jiaqing reign the waterways gradually silted up.
translations.idiomatic: After Jiaqing 6 the waterways gradually silted up.

sentences.zh: 道光二三兩年淫雨，被水者多至百餘州縣。

translations.literal: In the second and third years of the Daoguang reign excessive rains flooded more than a hundred prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 2 and 3 excessive rains flooded more than a hundred prefectures and counties.

sentences.zh: 治水如治病，必先明病之源流，急則治標，緩則治本。

translations.literal: Managing water is like treating illness: one must first understand the source and course of the disease; when urgent, treat the symptoms; when there is leisure, treat the root.
translations.idiomatic: Managing water is like treating illness: one must first understand the source and course of the disease. When urgent, treat the symptoms; when there is time, treat the root.

sentences.zh: 循古人經驗之良方，參今時變遷之證候，然後疾可得而治也。

translations.literal: Follow the proven remedies of the ancients and take account of present changes in conditions, and then the ailment may be cured.
translations.idiomatic: Follow the proven remedies of the ancients and take account of present changes in conditions, and then the ailment may be cured.

sentences.zh: 天津為眾水出海孔道，諸減河皆所以洩水入海。

translations.literal: Tianjin is the outlet through which the many waters reach the sea; the various relief rivers are all means of discharging water into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Tianjin is the outlet through which the many waters reach the sea; the various relief rivers are all means of discharging water into the sea.

sentences.zh: 東淀★環數百里，大清、子牙、永定、南運、北運五大川流貫其中。

translations.literal: The Eastern Marshes extend for several hundred li, with the five great rivers—the Daqing, Ziya, Yongding, Southern Transport, and Northern Transport—flowing through them.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Marshes extend for several hundred li, with the five great rivers—the Daqing, Ziya, Yongding, Southern Transport, and Northern Transport—flowing through them.

sentences.zh: 西淀容納順天、保定、河間三府二十餘河之水，南北兩泊容納正定、順德、廣平三十餘河之水，各有河道為傳送之區。

translations.literal: The Western Marshes receive the waters of more than twenty rivers from the three prefectures of Shuntian, Baoding, and Hejian; the northern and southern lakes receive the waters of more than thirty rivers from Zhengding, Shunde, and Guangping; each has waterways serving as channels of conveyance.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Marshes receive the waters of more than twenty rivers from Shuntian, Baoding, and Hejian. The northern and southern lakes receive the waters of more than thirty rivers from Zhengding, Shunde, and Guangping. Each has waterways serving as channels of conveyance.

sentences.zh: 今則消洩之尾閭無不阻塞，停蓄之腹部無不淺溢，流貫之腸無不壅滯，收納之脾胃無不平淺，傳送之機軸無不淤積，吐納之咽喉無不填閼，疏通之血脈無不凝滯，加以堤埝、閘壩、橋樑無不殘缺，霪潦一至，輒虞泛溢。

translations.literal: Now the outlets of discharge are all blocked, the reservoirs of storage are all shallow and overflowing, the channels of flow are all obstructed, the basins of reception are all level and shallow, the mechanisms of conveyance are all silted up, the throats of intake and outflow are all choked, and the veins of drainage are all stagnant; moreover dikes, sluices, dams, and bridges are all broken and missing—when excessive rains come, overflow is feared at once.
translations.idiomatic: Now the outlets of discharge are all blocked, the reservoirs of storage are all shallow and overflowing, the channels of flow are all obstructed, the basins of reception are all level and shallow, the mechanisms of conveyance are all silted up, the throats of intake and outflow are all choked, and the veins of drainage are all stagnant. Moreover dikes, sluices, dams, and bridges are all broken and missing. When excessive rains come, overflow is feared at once.

sentences.zh: 此畿輔水道受病之情形也。

translations.literal: This is the condition of affliction in the waterways of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: This is the condition of affliction in the waterways of the capital region.

sentences.zh: 伏思直隸河渠淀泊，前代不聞大患。

translations.literal: Reflecting on the rivers, canals, marshes, and lakes of Zhili, earlier ages heard of no great calamity.
translations.idiomatic: Reflecting on the rivers, canals, marshes, and lakes of Zhili, earlier ages heard of no great calamity.

sentences.zh: 自康熙三十九年以後，乃恆苦水潦，則永定、子牙二濁河築堤之所致耳。

translations.literal: From the thirty-ninth year of the Kangxi reign onward it constantly suffered floods—this was caused solely by building dikes on the two muddy rivers, the Yongding and Ziya.
translations.idiomatic: From Kangxi 39 onward it constantly suffered floods—this was caused solely by building dikes on the two muddy rivers, the Yongding and Ziya.

sentences.zh: 孫嘉淦有言，永定、子牙向皆無隄，泥塗得流行田間，而水不淤淀。

translations.literal: Sun Jiagan once said that the Yongding and Ziya had formerly had no dikes, so mud could spread through the fields and the water did not silt up and deposit.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Jiagan once said that the Yongding and Ziya had formerly had no dikes, so mud could spread through the fields and the water did not silt up and deposit.

sentences.zh: 自永定築堤束水，而勝芳、三角淀皆淤；

translations.literal: Once dikes were built on the Yongding to confine the water, Shengfang and Sanjiao Marshes both silted up;
translations.idiomatic: Once dikes were built on the Yongding to confine the water, Shengfang and Sanjiao Marshes both silted up;

sentences.zh: 自子牙築堤束水，而台頭等淀亦淤。

translations.literal: once dikes were built on the Ziya to confine the water, Taitou and other marshes also silted up.
translations.idiomatic: once dikes were built on the Ziya to confine the water, Taitou and other marshes also silted up.

sentences.zh: 淀口既淤，河身日高，則田水入河之道阻，於是淀病而全局皆病。

translations.literal: Once the marsh mouths silted up and the river bed rose day by day, the channels by which field water entered the rivers were blocked; thus the marshes fell ill and the whole system fell ill.
translations.idiomatic: Once the marsh mouths silted up and the river bed rose day by day, the channels by which field water entered the rivers were blocked. Thus the marshes fell ill and the whole system fell ill.

sentences.zh: 即永定一河，亦已不勝其弊，總因濁水入淀，溜散泥沉，以致斯疾。

translations.literal: Even the Yongding alone can no longer bear its abuses; all stem from muddy water entering the marshes, spreading and depositing silt, and thus producing this disease.
translations.idiomatic: Even the Yongding alone can no longer bear its abuses. All stem from muddy water entering the marshes, spreading and depositing silt, and thus producing this disease.

sentences.zh: 此又畿輔水道致病之根原也。

translations.literal: This is again the root cause of disease in the waterways of the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: This is again the root cause of disease in the waterways of the capital region.

sentences.zh: 永定河自築堤以來，於今百有餘年。

translations.literal: Since dikes were built on the Yongding River, more than a hundred years have passed to this day.
translations.idiomatic: Since dikes were built on the Yongding River, more than a hundred years have passed.

sentences.zh: 河身高出平地一丈有餘，既不能挑之使平，又不能廢堤不用，明知痼疾所在，無術可治。

translations.literal: The river bed stands more than a zhang above the plain; it can neither be dredged level nor can the dikes be abandoned, and though one knows where the chronic disease lies, there is no remedy.
translations.idiomatic: The river bed stands more than a zhang above the plain. It can neither be dredged level nor can the dikes be abandoned. Though one knows where the chronic disease lies, there is no remedy.

sentences.zh: 亦惟見病治病，多開閘壩以分其勢，高築堤埝以御其衝，使不致潰決為害而已。

translations.literal: One can only treat the illness as it appears: open many sluices and dams to divide its force, build dikes high to withstand its rush, so that it does not burst and cause harm—that is all.
translations.idiomatic: One can only treat the illness as it appears: open many sluices and dams to divide its force and build dikes high to withstand its rush, so that it does not burst and cause harm—that is all.

sentences.zh: 至通省全局工段繁多，自不能同時並舉。

translations.literal: As for the whole province, the works sections are numerous and cannot all be undertaken at once.
translations.idiomatic: As for the whole province, the works sections are numerous and cannot all be undertaken at once.

sentences.zh: 惟有用治標之法，先將各河淀挑挖寬深，取出之土即以築堤，使窪水悉得下注，然後廓清中部。

translations.literal: One must use symptomatic methods: first dredge all rivers and marshes wide and deep, using the excavated earth immediately to build dikes so that low-lying water can all drain downward, and then clear the central region.
translations.idiomatic: One must use symptomatic methods: first dredge all rivers and marshes wide and deep, using the excavated earth immediately to build dikes so that low-lying water can all drain downward, and then clear the central region.

sentences.zh: 俟大端就理，乃用治本之策，諸州縣支港溝渠，逐一疏通，俾民間灌溉有資，旱潦有備，三五年後，元氣漸復。

translations.literal: When the main lines are set in order, then apply root-cure measures: clear branch harbors and ditches in every prefecture and county one by one, so that irrigation for the people has resources and drought and flood have provision; after three to five years vital energy will gradually recover.
translations.idiomatic: When the main lines are set in order, then apply root-cure measures: clear branch harbors and ditches in every prefecture and county one by one, so that irrigation has resources and drought and flood have provision. After three to five years vital energy will gradually recover.

sentences.zh: 此又辦理之先後次第也。

translations.literal: This is again the order of priority in handling the matter.
translations.idiomatic: This is again the order of priority in handling the matter.

sentences.zh: 造端宏大，倍於乾隆時，與其緩辦費多，不如速辦費少，計非一二百萬所能成事。

translations.literal: The undertaking is vast, twice that of the Qianlong period; rather than proceeding slowly at greater expense, it is better to proceed quickly at less expense, but it will require no less than one or two million to complete.
translations.idiomatic: The undertaking is vast, twice that of the Qianlong period. Rather than proceeding slowly at greater expense, it is better to proceed quickly at less expense, but it will require no less than one or two million to complete.

sentences.zh: 請飭部寬籌經費，庶不致有始無終。

translations.literal: I request that the ministries be ordered to allocate funds generously, so that the work does not begin only to end unfinished.
translations.idiomatic: I request that the ministries be ordered to allocate funds generously, so that the work does not begin only to end unfinished.

sentences.zh: 」又疏陳應修各工，略謂：「治水在一'導'字。

translations.idiomatic: " He also memorialized on the works that should be repaired, writing in summary: "Water control lies in the single word 'guide.'

sentences.zh: 欲治上游，先治下游；

translations.literal: To treat the upper reaches, first treat the lower reaches;
translations.idiomatic: To treat the upper reaches, first treat the lower reaches;

sentences.zh: 欲治旁流，先治中流。

translations.literal: to treat branch flows, first treat the middle reaches.
translations.idiomatic: to treat branch flows, first treat the middle reaches.

sentences.zh: 挑賈家口以洩永定、子牙、北運、大清四河之水。

translations.literal: Dredge Jiajiakou to discharge the waters of the Yongding, Ziya, Northern Transport, and Daqing rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Dredge Jiajiakou to discharge the waters of the Yongding, Ziya, Northern Transport, and Daqing rivers.

sentences.zh: 挑西堤頭引河以洩塌水淀之水，挑邢家坨以洩七里海之水。

translations.literal: Dredge the diversion channel at Xiditou to discharge the waters of Tashui Marsh, and dredge Xingjiatuo to discharge the waters of Qilihai.
translations.idiomatic: Dredge the diversion channel at Xiditou to discharge the waters of Tashui Marsh, and dredge Xingjiatuo to discharge the waters of Qilihai.

sentences.zh: 另開北岸一河以分罾口之勢，修復減河以宣白、榆之源；

translations.literal: open another river on the north bank to divide the force at Zengkou, and restore relief rivers to release the sources of the Bai and Yu;
translations.idiomatic: Open another river on the north bank to divide the force at Zengkou, and restore relief rivers to release the sources of the Bai and Yu;

sentences.zh: 挑濬三河頭水道，添建草壩，為東淀之扼要；

translations.literal: dredge the waterway at Sanhetou and add earthen dams, which are critical to the Eastern Marshes;
translations.idiomatic: dredge the waterway at Sanhetou and add earthen dams, which are critical to the Eastern Marshes;

sentences.zh: 挑濬馬道河、趙北口水道，為西淀之扼要。

translations.literal: dredge the waterways of Madao River and Zhaobeikou, which are critical to the Western Marshes.
translations.idiomatic: dredge the waterways of Madao River and Zhaobeikou, which are critical to the Western Marshes.

sentences.zh: 十二連橋橫亙淀中，亟應興修以利往來。

translations.literal: The Twelve Linked Bridges span the marshes and should urgently be rebuilt to facilitate travel.
translations.idiomatic: The Twelve Linked Bridges span the marshes and should urgently be rebuilt to facilitate travel.

sentences.zh: 修復增河，分白溝上游之勢，修復窯河，分白溝下游之勢，則水得就下之性，支派旁流，乃可次第導引。

translations.literal: Restore the Zeng River to divide the force of the upper Baigou, restore the Yao River to divide the force of the lower Baigou; then water may follow its nature to seek the lower level, and branch streams may be guided in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Restore the Zeng River to divide the force of the upper Baigou and restore the Yao River to divide the force of the lower Baigou. Then water may follow its nature to seek the lower level, and branch streams may be guided in turn.

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, both were commended and approved.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial was submitted, both were commended and approved.

sentences.zh: 實授工部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was formally appointed Vice Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He was formally appointed Vice Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 尋調倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was transferred to Vice Minister in charge of the grain depots.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was transferred to Vice Minister in charge of the grain depots.

sentences.zh: 五年，授浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 六年，以病辭職，上以含章精力未衰，不許，調山東。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he resigned on grounds of illness; the emperor, believing Hanzhang's energy was not yet spent, did not permit it and transferred him to Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he resigned on grounds of illness. The emperor, believing Hanzhang's energy was not yet spent, did not permit it and transferred him to Shandong.

sentences.zh: 七年，因浙江巡撫劉彬士治鹽操切，密疏劾其不職，命總督孫爾準按治不實，詔斥含章聽不根之言，無端入告，解職嚴議。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, because Zhejiang Governor Liu Binshi managed salt affairs harshly, he submitted a secret memorial impeaching him for malfeasance; Governor-General Sun Erzhun was ordered to investigate and found the charge unsubstantiated. An edict rebuked Hanzhang for listening to groundless talk and making accusations without cause; he was removed from office for severe deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, because Zhejiang Governor Liu Binshi managed salt affairs harshly, Hanzhang submitted a secret memorial impeaching him for malfeasance. Governor-General Sun Erzhun was ordered to investigate and found the charge unsubstantiated. An edict rebuked Hanzhang for listening to groundless talk and making accusations without cause. He was removed from office for severe deliberation.

sentences.zh: 彬士亦劾含章提用商綱銀，額外濫支，漏追餘款等事。

translations.literal: Binshi also impeached Hanzhang for appropriating merchant certificate silver, making unauthorized extra expenditures, and failing to recover surplus funds, among other matters.
translations.idiomatic: Binshi also impeached Hanzhang for appropriating merchant certificate silver, making unauthorized extra expenditures, and failing to recover surplus funds, among other matters.

sentences.zh: 含章疏辨，命總督琦善、學政硃士彥按之。

translations.literal: Hanzhang memorialized in defense; Governor-General Qishan and Educational Commissioner Zhu Shiyan were ordered to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Hanzhang memorialized in defense. Governor-General Qishan and Educational Commissioner Zhu Shiyan were ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 詔以提用綱銀，歸還捐墊，僅屬見小，而先發妄奏之咎重，念其居官尚好，降補刑部員外郎。

translations.literal: An edict held that appropriating certificate silver and returning donated advances was merely petty-mindedness, but the graver fault lay in making groundless accusations first; considering that his conduct in office had still been good, he was demoted to department director in the Ministry of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: An edict held that appropriating certificate silver and returning donated advances was merely petty-mindedness, but the graver fault lay in making groundless accusations first. Considering that his conduct in office had still been good, he was demoted to department director in the Ministry of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 八年，授福建布政使，以病乞歸。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed provincial treasurer of Fujian and requested retirement on grounds of illness.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was appointed provincial treasurer of Fujian and requested retirement on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he died.

sentences.zh: =康紹鏞=康紹鏞，字蘭皋，山西興縣人，江西廣信知府基淵子。

translations.literal: Kang Shaoyong, styled Langao, was a native of Xingxian in Shanxi and son of Ji Yuan, prefect of Guangxin in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Shaoyong, whose courtesy name was Langao, came from Xingxian in Shanxi and was the son of Ji Yuan, prefect of Guangxin in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年進士，授兵部主事，充軍機章京。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi in the fourth year of the Jiaqing reign, was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of War, and served as a Grand Council clerk.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examinations in Jiaqing 4, was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of War, and served as a Grand Council clerk.

sentences.zh: 累遷郎中，擢鴻臚寺少卿。

translations.literal: He was promoted in due course to director and then to Vice Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial.
translations.idiomatic: He rose step by step to director and then to Vice Minister of the Court of State Ceremonial.

sentences.zh: 十八年，滑縣教匪起，紹鏞隨扈，以畿輔、山東、河南地形險易，將帥賢否，各鎮兵籍，列冊進禦，受仁宗知。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year sect rebels rose at Huaxian; Shaoyong accompanied the imperial entourage and submitted registers on the terrain and strategic points of the capital region, Shandong, and Henan, the merit of commanders, and the troop rolls of each garrison, winning Emperor Renzong's notice.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year sect rebels rose at Huaxian. Shaoyong accompanied the imperial entourage and submitted registers on the terrain and strategic points of the capital region, Shandong, and Henan, the merit of commanders, and the troop rolls of each garrison, winning Emperor Renzong's notice.

sentences.zh: 會有大名民人司敬武等十餘人傭工熱河、錦州，聞​​畿南寇起，馳歸，過山海關，關吏執之，誣其預聞逆謀，命紹鏞偕內閣學士文孚往鞫，白其誣，釋之。

translations.literal: It happened that more than ten men of Daming, including Si Jingwu, were hired laborers in Rehe and Jinzhou; hearing that bandits had risen south of the capital, they hurried home, passed Shanhaiguan, and were seized by the gate officers who falsely accused them of foreknowledge of rebellion. Shaoyong was ordered to go with Grand Secretariat Academician Wen Fu to try the case, cleared the false charge, and released them.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten men of Daming, including Si Jingwu, were hired laborers in Rehe and Jinzhou.
